mapper.sql: goods_spu.id AS spu_id, goods_spu.`name` AS `name`, goods_spu.`status` AS `status`, profile.sale_scope, profile.impa_code, profile.issa_code, profile.internal_item_code, profile.barcode, profile.name_en, profile.storage_type, profile.publish_completeness, sku_profile.sku_id, sku_profile.base_unit, sku_profile.purchase_unit, sku_profile.package_spec, sku_profile.moq, sku_profile.step_qty, goods_sku.sales_price, goods_sku.stock
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM goods_spu INNER JOIN ship_goods_profile profile ON profile.spu_id = goods_spu.id AND profile.tenant_id = goods_spu.tenant_id AND profile.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ship_sku_profile sku_profile ON sku_profile.spu_id = goods_spu.id AND sku_profile.tenant_id = goods_spu.tenant_id AND sku_profile.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN goods_sku ON goods_sku.id = sku_profile.sku_id AND goods_sku.tenant_id = goods_spu.tenant_id AND goods_sku.del_flag = '0' WHERE goods_spu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND goods_spu.del_flag = '0' AND profile.sale_scope IN ('1', '3')
AND (goods_spu.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.nameEn}, '%') OR profile.name_en LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.nameEn}, '%'))
AND goods_spu.`status` = #{query.status}
ORDER BY goods_spu.create_time DESC
